findings.title: totalPages/currentPage off by one when count is a multiple of limit
findings.body: `totalPages` is `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`. With user_count=50 and limit=50 it returns 2 pages although only one page of members exists; the 'next' button becomes enabled and fetches an empty page. The same `+1` logic in `currentPage` means when offset == user_count the displayed page number exceeds the real last page. Use `Math.ceil(user_count / limit)` (and clamp currentPage accordingly).

findings.title: Unbounded/unvalidated limit and offset on public members endpoint
findings.body: `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` are taken straight from user input with no upper bound or non-negative check. An anonymous caller can request `limit=1000000` on a large group and serialize the whole membership (memory/CPU DoS), and a negative `limit`/`offset` produces an invalid SQL LIMIT/OFFSET which raises and returns a 500. Clamp limit to a maximum (e.g. 50..100) and force offset >= 0.

findings.title: create ignores alias_level sent by the client
findings.body: `Group#asJSON` in the JS model now sends `name`, `alias_level` and `visible` for both create and update, but `create` only reads `name` and `visible`. A new group created from the admin UI with a non-default alias level silently gets the default alias_level, and the client never issues a follow-up save, so the admin's choice is lost.

findings.title: update forces visible=false when the visible param is absent
findings.body: `group.visible = params[:visible] == "true"` unconditionally assigns, so any PUT that omits `visible` (e.g. an API client sending only `name` or `alias_level`) silently makes the group invisible. Only assign when `params.key?(:visible)`.

findings.title: remove_member automatic-group test uses PUT, but the route is DELETE
findings.body: The spec issues `xhr :put, :remove_member, ...` while config/routes.rb only maps `delete "members" => groups#remove_member` (PUT maps to add_members). Controller specs generate the URL from routes, so this raises ActionController::UrlGenerationError / exercises the wrong verb, leaving the automatic-group guard for removal effectively untested.

findings.title: Tests rely on hard-coded group id 1 being an automatic group
findings.body: `add_members`/`remove_member`/`update` specs pass `group_id: 1` / `id: 1` and assert 422 or 'name unchanged', implicitly assuming the seeded group with id 1 exists and is automatic. If seed order or ids change these tests break or pass for the wrong reason (e.g. Group.find(1) raising RecordNotFound). Fabricate an automatic group explicitly.

findings.title: findMembers no longer always returns a promise
findings.body: When `name` is empty the method returns `undefined` instead of the previous `Ember.RSVP.resolve([])`. Any caller doing `group.findMembers().then(...)` (routes/controllers outside this diff, or future callers) will throw a TypeError. Return a resolved promise instead of bare `return;`.

findings.title: Non-block {{each}} with itemView has no closing tag and may not render
findings.body: `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}` is used as an inline (non-block) helper with no `{{/each}}`. If the Ember version in use does not support the legacy non-block `{{each}}` form with the `member in` binding, the template will either fail to compile or render nothing, so the member list and the remove buttons will not appear. Use the block form `{{#each member in members itemView="group-member"}}{{/each}}` (or a component).
